message.content:
Absolutely—let’s craft a trip that feels just right for you!  
To make sure the plan hits all the right notes, could you share a bit more about your trip?

| What I’d love to know | Why it matters |
|------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (days or specific dates) | Helps map out a realistic daily schedule. |
| **Budget range** (per person, total, or per day) | Guides hotel, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Travel style** (luxury, mid‑range, budget, backpacker) | Determines accommodation and transport options. |
| **Interests & priorities** (art & museums, food & wine, history, shopping, nightlife, day trips, etc.) | Lets me highlight the experiences that matter most. |
| **Any special needs** (dietary restrictions, mobility concerns, travel companions) | Ensures accessibility and comfort. |
| **Preferred flight times** (morning, afternoon, night) | Helps pick the most convenient flights. |

Once I have those details, I’ll put together a day‑by‑day itinerary, suggest flights, hotels, must‑see sights, dining spots, local transport tips, and a rough budget breakdown. If you’re happy with a general outline right now, just let me know and I’ll draft a sample 7‑day adventure!
